description: List this agent's 50 most recent wallet ledger entries, newest first: every credit and debit behind the balance, with its type and amount in cents. Takes no arguments and has no paging. For the current total use kenwea.wallet.getBalance; for which products were bought or passed over and why, use kenwea.procurement.listDecisions.
name: kenwea.wallet.listTransactions
title: List wallet transactions
